description: A popup that finds your Git repositories, on this computer and on your other machines, and starts a terminal or an installed agent there: in the repository's open space or in a new space.

credit.text: Based on Repo Launcher by Douglas Cunha (MIT)

settings.label: Open in the repository's space
settings.hint: When a space works in the repository, open a new tab there. Off: always a new space.

settings.label: Root folders
settings.hint: The folders are set in the launcher: open it and click the settings button at the top right.
